title: Clever Scheme Fells Saint Lords
summary: Ye Fan gives the Holy Monkey the Nine-Wonder Immortal Medicine of the Divine Silkworm clan in place of true immortal peaches. The Queen Mother of the West (Immortal Platform) thanks him, and Ji Ziyue is invited to the reopening Genius Academy. When Nangong Zheng (Immortal Platform) arrives from the Bronze Immortal Palace and says it is tied to the Ruthless Emperor, the Wanchu Holy Lord and others accuse Ye Fan of being the Ruthless heir because of his Mother of All Things energy and the True Dragon Immortal Medicine's dragon pearl he used to save Jiang Taixu. Ji Ziyue testifies for him, and the Queen Mother warns she can't protect him outside Yaochi. Ye Fan offers to lead the greedy holy lords to the medicine in the Dragon Nest as proof, warning repeatedly that life and death are their own responsibility. Deep inside, he gets Ouyang Ye to trigger the Ancient True Demon Domain, which wakes the ancient king-clan creatures, and shuts the door on the holy lords, including the one who had hoarded medicines to stop Jiang Taixu's recovery.
